title: Microsoft Entra Domain Services: sAMAccountName synchronised from on-premises Active Directory
summary: The briefing passes: the portal control, preview Python SDK operation, SKU requirements and hourly billing are supported by Microsoft documentation. It correctly distinguishes opt-in for existing domains from Microsoft's conflicting statements about new-domain defaults, and identifies the feature as public preview.

claims.claim: sAMAccountName stores the legacy Active Directory logon name.
claims.quote: The security account manager account name (sAMAccountName) attribute stores a user’s legacy logon name in Active Directory Domain Services
